scripts.build: npm run build:contracts && npm run db:generate && npm run build -w @dayari/api && npm run build -w @dayari/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:contracts && tsc --noEmit -p apps/api/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p apps/web/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json
scripts.test: npm run build:contracts && node scripts/run-vitest.mjs run
scripts.test:integration: npm run build:contracts && node scripts/run-vitest.mjs run --config vitest.integration.config.ts
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build:contracts && npm run db:generate && npm run build -w @dayari/api && playwright test
